title: Without See Financial Data line prices and margins stay hidden
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit' but not 'See Financial Data'. An Admin makes the records below before the test.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a part line.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The part line shows its description and quantity.
  • Its price and margin are hidden, as today.
